The current implementation of the Control Alarm Panel of the Elmax component  does not correctly handle the case of a wrong disarming code. 

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2024.5.3

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

elmax

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/elmax

### Diagnostics information

_No response_

### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

_No response_

### Additional information

Specifying a wrong disarm code shows a "unknown error" message. User should be warned that the code was wrong, instead.
